summary: Tested Phase 1 Hybrid Smart Pricing & Legal Consents. Backend: 16/17 pytest passing. Legal content endpoints (T&C, Privacy, Cancellation) return correct v1.0 content with effective_date 03.08.2026. Consents endpoint returns 5 mandatory (excluding village_landing) by default and 6 including village_landing when booking_type=village_landing. Route search endpoint returns suggest_auction=true when no routes match. Fixed route CRUD works for operators with duplicate-detection. Frontend: All 3 legal pages (/legal/terms, /legal/privacy, /legal/cancellation) load content correctly from backend. BookingPage code review confirms 5-checkbox consent state, allConsentsAccepted gate, and submit button disabled when any consent unchecked (data-testid=submit-inquiry-btn, disabled prop includes !allConsentsAccepted).

critical.issue: Endpoint requires ALL mandatory consents including 'village_landing' regardless of booking type. Frontend only sends 5 consents (terms_conditions, flight_conditions, platform_role, passenger_info, electronic_consent) as UI omits village_landing for non-village bookings. Result: booking inquiry submission via consent recording API will ALWAYS FAIL with 400 'Missing mandatory consents: village_landing' for normal/round_trip bookings. Root cause: legal_routes.py line 607 `mandatory_ids = [c['id'] for c in MANDATORY_CONSENTS if c.get('required')]` does not filter by `show_for` field the way GET /api/legal/consents does (line 577). Fix: filter by booking_type similar to GET, or make village_landing conditionally required based on booking_id/booking_type in the request payload.

integration_issues.issue: BookingPage does NOT call POST /api/legal/consents/record — consents are only embedded in inquiry payload (consents_accepted object). If backend expects a separate consent-record call before payment, integration is missing. Verify with product owner whether consent should be persisted independently via /api/legal/consents/record.

action_items: Fix legal_routes.py record_booking_consent: filter MANDATORY_CONSENTS by `show_for` (mirror the GET /api/legal/consents logic) or accept booking_type in ConsentRecord payload so village_landing is only required when applicable. Currently 100% of non-village consent-record calls will fail.
Clarify whether BookingPage should invoke POST /api/legal/consents/record before creating the inquiry (currently consents are only embedded in inquiry payload).
critical_code_review_comments: legal_routes.py:607 - mandatory_ids computation ignores `show_for` filter used in GET /consents; causes universal validation failure for non-village bookings.
fixed_route_pricing_routes.py:363 - `datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)` mixes aware/naive datetime with parsed naive travel_date; works but fragile. Consider consistent tz handling.

Full E2E frontend booking flow (steps 1→4) requires seeded landing points; if testing consent gating UI, log in as loyaltytest@airyatra.com/Loyalty@123 and walk through all 4 steps, then assert submit-inquiry-btn disabled attr toggles with each of the 5 checkboxes.
rca_of_the_issue: In /app/backend/routes/legal_routes.py, GET /consents filters MANDATORY_CONSENTS by `show_for` matching booking_type so village_landing consent is hidden by default. However POST /consents/record's validation (line 607) picks ALL required consents, so village_landing is always required. The frontend BookingPage state only tracks 5 consents (terms/flight/platform/info/electronic) omitting village_landing. Any POST /consents/record from a normal booking returns HTTP 400 'Missing mandatory consents: village_landing'. Fix: honor booking_type/show_for in the validation path, e.g., accept booking_type in ConsentRecord and compute mandatory_ids the same way as the GET endpoint.
